method: Sequential matched baseline and candidate. Three fresh implicit wallets per arm. Same custody versions. One SDK and harness serve both arms. Only Gateway finalization scheduling, its founding-record read batch, and diagnostics differ. Only the NEAR signer is loaded. First signature is an independently verified NEP-413 message without account funding.
scope: Existing staging testnet resources. No new infrastructure or package release.
changes: Read founding authority and auth method in one D1 batch while checking the global credential claim.
Overlap capability installation and custody-envelope persistence after wallet records commit, waiting for both before returning or retrying.
Preserve identity, revocation, credential collision, ownership fences, idempotency and failure checks.
Measure Router consumption, capability installation, custody storage, session issuance, and reservation admission/completion separately.

outcome: Median finalization HTTP decreased from 3580.620ms to 3046.908ms, an observed reduction of 533.712ms (14.91%). This is a small sequential comparison, not a repeatable latency guarantee. Registration and Yao targets remain unmet.
limitations: Three sequential samples per arm establish neither percentiles nor a maximum guarantee.
Authenticated Yao and wallet-commit metrics sum corresponding HTTP durations per sample, never stage medians.
Browser registration-to-signature time includes automation and UI settlement. Fresh wallets do not prove cold Workers or DOs.
Gateway-wide D1 and backend Console call counts remain unknown. Application timers omit some CPU work.
Existing APAC home hints remain. Actual physical colocation was not remeasured.

backgroundCleanup.change: Schedule terminal ceremony deletion with the existing Worker waitUntil callback, after both the completion receipt and home completion are durable. Inline runtimes continue to await deletion.
boundariesPreserved: Wallet, signer, custody envelope, recovery data and session storage remain awaited.

The completion receipt remains authoritative for retry and lost-reply recovery.
